response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI systems in fintech, regulatory compliance experience, or leadership scaling engineering teams beyond 10 people — critical gaps for a CTO role in high-stakes AI-driven fintech infrastructure.
strengths: Exposure to agentic AI tooling and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven ability to build event-driven, scalable systems (GISCollective, DLang microservices)
Strong engineering culture advocacy (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source)
concerns: No evidence of designing or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or building senior leadership layers
Minimal mention of real-time inference, credit-risk modeling, or financial compliance infrastructure
